After finishing the Kobe Shimbun Hai and 
returning, Silence Suzuka wore a 
refreshed, serene expression on her face.

Armed with an unshakable resolve, Silence 
Suzuka wishes to enter the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).

Setting her sights on a major goal, she 
decided to run in the Kinko Sho to build 
up her track record.
